Okay, so, right now at least, Mexico isn't the most stable country. There's also this small problem...

I think Mexico should go through some sort of civil war in the nation before the government truly begins cracking down on these rebellions and builds up a military force capable of being on par with the United States. It could even cause the Renacido. Just a thought though.<ac_metadata title="Civil conflict in Mexico"> </ac_metadata>
